content: The TcpIp shall call <Up_PhysAddrTableChg > () directly after each ARP table change: (a) If TcpIp ad ds a new entry or updates an existing one, the parameter valid shall be set to TRUE and the paramet ers IpAddrPtr and PhysAddrPtr shall be set according to the new or updated entry. (b) In case TcpIp removes an entry, valid shall be set to FALSE and the parameters IpAddrPtr and PhysAddrPtr shall be set according to the removed entry.
